requirements.title: Unformatted records contain value sequences of any type or no data
requirements.definition: An unformatted record consists of a sequence of values and may contain data of any type or no data.

pending.unformatted-value-sequence: Write a nondefault integer and logical value to an unformatted record and read into different sentinels; assert recovered values, not representation bytes.
pending.unformatted-any-type-or-no-data: Use future controls with one typed value record and one empty unformatted record bracketed by nonempty records so an empty record is not confused with no operation.

requirements.oracle: Plans are pending and source-derived. Positive plans establish a non-default state first (for example by writing known records, initializing variables to nonzero/nonblank sentinels, or creating a known file) and then observe only portable properties: exact internal records, successful IOSTAT zero, nonzero IOSTAT for a specified error condition, or named intrinsic status values where the standard names them. Processor-dependent unit numbers, file names, record lengths, storage-unit encodings, buffering, timing, IOMSG text, and specific error numbers are not asserted.

requirements.title: Unformatted record length is measured in file storage units and depends on the output list
requirements.definition: The length of an unformatted record is measured in file storage units and depends on the output list used when it is written.

pending.unformatted-length-file-storage-units: Future plan uses INQUIRE/POS only where registered to observe position movement portably; it does not assert byte counts.
pending.unformatted-length-output-list-dependent: Write records with one and two scalar values and observe portable ability to read corresponding value counts; exact storage-unit lengths remain unasserted.

requirements.title: Unformatted records are read or written only by unformatted input/output statements
requirements.definition: Unformatted records shall be read or written only by unformatted input/output statements.

requirements.title: Unformatted record length has processor/media latitude and may be zero
requirements.definition: Unformatted record length may depend on the processor and external medium, and may be zero.

pending.unformatted-length-processor-or-medium-d: No portable oracle may require a specific unformatted record length for an external medium.
pending.unformatted-zero-length-record-permitted: Write an empty unformatted record between two value records and read through all three positions after positioning rules are registered; surrounding values prevent vacuous success.

review_rationale: Source registration for Clause 12 (batch145), the clause's first packet. Every base and fine unit classified and hash-verified against the pinned J3/24-007 census by an independent fresh-context reviewer who read the original pages 242-246 and confirmed 12.3.3.4 ends before 12.3.4.1. Mixed obligation/latitude units were swept in both directions and all splits recorded; no unit left unresolved; no numbered R/C rule in scope; no requirement based on a NOTE; no no-portable-oracle claim found to be over-suppression and no pending plan found vacuous. Source accounting only: no fixture, compiler invocation or execution credit.
